name: Yoma Mandalay International Marathon
short_description: The Yoma Mandalay International Marathon was a half marathon, 10 km and 5 km race held in Mandalay, Myanmar, on 24 January 2026, its first edition.
ai_summary: The Yoma Mandalay International Marathon held its first edition on 24 January 2026 in Mandalay, Myanmar, organised by Yoma, over 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km. The organiser says the race enters a new chapter in 2027 but has not published a date for the next edition.

core_facts.venue: Mandalay (exact start point not yet published)

pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km) to suit different runner levels
Takes place in the historic city of Mandalay, Myanmar
Organized by Yoma, providing a structured event framework

faqs.question: When is the Yoma Mandalay International Marathon?
faqs.answer: The first edition was held on 24 January 2026. The organiser says the race returns in 2027 but has not yet published a date, so check its website before planning around it.

faqs.question: What distances are offered?
faqs.answer: The event offers three distance options for participants: a 21.1km half-marathon, which is the primary distance, along with 10km and 5km races. This range allows runners of varying experience levels and fitness goals to select the distance that best suits them.
